purpose: a frozen, scored-once measurement of the engine on unenriched PubChem molecules; see the docstring of tools/naming_fresh_draw.py
selection_rule: PubChem CIDs 1000 * k + 875 for k = 1..12000, ascending, admitting the first 2000 rows that pass the filter
admission_filter: PubChem returns both SMILES and a non-empty IUPACName
canonical SMILES not in any registered population, the B2 battery, or the census
not_filtered: whether PubChem's name parses back (no trust filter)
inspection_policy: evaluation only: drawn before anything was known about it, scored once by naming_stage_artifact.py --final-evaluation --only fresh_v1 as aggregates, never inspected row by row
